recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中脂肪細胞大量佔據、造血組織只剩細窄條索（低細胞性），其中可見數顆小型巨核細胞，核圓形、不分葉或分葉很少（hypolobated/monolobated），是發育不良巨核細胞的線索；紅血球系與顆粒球系仍可見。
features: Hypocellular marrow with predominance of adipocytes and thin cords of hematopoietic tissue
Megakaryocytes small to medium-sized with round, non-lobated or hypolobated nuclei (dysplastic forms)
Megakaryocyte nuclei with open chromatin and small nucleoli, surrounded by moderate eosinophilic cytoplasm
Trilineage hematopoiesis present: erythroid precursors with dark round nuclei and granulocytic cells with eosinophilic cytoplasm
No clusters of blasts or fibrosis evident in this field
describe_en: Bone marrow trephine biopsy (H&E) shows a hypocellular marrow with abundant adipocytes and narrow cords of residual hematopoietic tissue. Trilineage hematopoiesis is present, including erythroid precursors and maturing granulocytic cells. Several megakaryocytes are small with round, non-lobated or hypolobated nuclei, consistent with megakaryocytic dysplasia. No blast aggregates or fibrosis are evident in this field. Findings are consistent with a hypocellular myelodysplastic syndrome with single lineage (megakaryocytic) dysplasia, in the appropriate clinical and cytogenetic context.

ddx.vs: Aplastic anemia shows a hypocellular marrow without megakaryocytic dysplasia and with markedly reduced or absent megakaryocytes, rather than preserved dysplastic hypolobated forms.
del(5q) MDS also has small hypolobated megakaryocytes but is usually normo- to hypercellular and defined by the 5q deletion on cytogenetics.
Hypocellular AML shows ≥20% blasts, often highlighted by CD34 immunostaining, which are not seen here.
